    FAQs

    Your questions, answered

    What is Bold Care?

    Bold Care is a men's health and wellness brand that offers a range of products designed to enhance sexual health, immunity, hair growth, and overall well-being.

    Why was Bold Care founded?

    Bold Care was founded to address the growing need for accessible and effective health solutions for men in India, promoting open discussions around men's health.

    Who are the founders of Bold Care?

    The brand was co-founded by Rajat Jadhav, Rahul Krishnan, Harsh Singh, and Mohit Yadav, who share a vision of empowering men to take charge of their health.

    What types of products does Bold Care offer?

    We offer a variety of products including condoms, lubricants, chewables, gummies, and health supplements focused on various aspects of men's wellness.
